meta.name: yt2bb
meta.description: Use when the user wants to repurpose a YouTube video for Bilibili, add bilingual (English-Chinese) subtitles to a video, or create hardcoded subtitle versions for Chinese platforms.

copy.tagline: 为YouTube视频添加双语字幕并适配B站
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把YouTube视频转到B站并加上中英字幕
copy.tagline_en: Repurpose YouTube videos for Bilibili with bilingual subtitles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to move YouTube videos to Bilibili with bilingual subtitles

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 YouTube 视频转成适合 Bilibili 的版本，包括下载、生成双语字幕并烧录到视频里，最后输出发布信息。
howto.when: 当你给出 YouTube 视频链接，并希望为 Bilibili 重新制作、添加双语字幕或制作硬字幕版本时触发。

say.text: 给这个视频加上中英双语字幕：https://youtu.be/xxx
say.note: Claude 会下载、转录、翻译并合并字幕。

say.text: 把这个 YouTube 播放列表里的视频都转成 Bilibili 格式
say.note: Claude 会逐个处理播放列表中的每个视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can repurpose a YouTube video for Bilibili: download, transcribe, translate, merge bilingual subtitles, burn them into the video, and generate publish metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a YouTube URL and want a Bilibili-ready version, bilingual subtitles, or hardcoded subtitles for Chinese platforms.

say_en.text: Repurpose this YouTube video for Bilibili: https://youtu.be/xxx
Add bilingual EN-ZH subtitles to this video: https://youtu.be/xxx
say_en.note: Claude downloads, transcribes, translates, and merges subtitles.

say_en.text: Convert this YouTube playlist to Bilibili format
say_en.note: Claude processes each video in the playlist sequentially.
